WHEREAS, the Town of Sharpsburg (the “Town”) desires to enact an amendment to the Town Charter (the “Charter”) amending the oath of office for the Mayor and members of the Town Council; and

WHEREAS, the Georgia General Assembly enacted a Charter for the Town on Match 24, 1978; and

WHEREAS, Code Section 36-35-3 of the Official Code of Georgia allows to a municipal corporation to amend its charter; and

WHEREAS, the Mayor and Town Council have complied with all of the requirements of Code Section 36-35-3 in regards to amending the Charter; and

WHEREAS, Section 2-30 of the Charter states the oath of office for the Mayor and members of the Town Council; and

WHEREAS, the Mayor and Town Council desire to enact the following ordinance thereby amending Article II of the Town of Sharpsburg Charter;

WHEREFORE THE TOWN OF SHARPSBURG HEREBY ADOPTS AND ORDAINS THE FOLLOWING ORDINANCE:
4: The Town hereby enacts and ordains an amendment to Article Il of the Town of Sharpsburg Charter by deleting Section 2-30 in its entirety and by enacting and ordaining the following language to be codified at Section 2-30 of the Town’s Charter as follows:
6: This Ordinance shall become immediately effective upon its second reading and adoption by the Town Council.
7:
The Preamble of this Ordinance shall be construed to be, and is hereby incorporated by reference as is fully set out herein.

ARTICLE FOUR The sections, paragraphs, sentences, clauses, and phrases of this Ordinance are severable, and if any phrase, sentence, paragraph, or section of this Ordinance shall be declared illegal by the valid judgment or decree of any court of competent jurisdiction, such an illegality shall not affect any of the remaining phrases, clauses, sentences, paragraphs, and sections of this Ordinance. ARTICLE FIVE This Ordinance shall be codified at said Article If of the Town of Sharpsburg Charter. ARTICLE SIX

All ordinances and parts of ordinances in conflict herewith are hereby expressly repealed.
